As a company case study

When the title is formally recognized

questions.prompt: A student team is choosing a new captain. According to Chapter 10, what should matter most?

explanation.direct: The conclusion asks whether the leader can keep the system linked and carried over time.

questions.prompt: Why does the chapter keep people, strategy, and operations together in the conclusion?
